name: Post-settlement welcome
subject: Your loan has settled. Here is what happens next.
bodyHtml:
Hi {{contact.firstName}},

Congratulations on settlement for {{application.applicationId}}.

We will keep monitoring your lending position and contact you before any useful review points, rate changes, or restructure opportunities.

Regards,
{{broker.signature}}
